description: Example cross-skill combination rules. Catalog rows keep their own numbers; this document says how they combine when more than one listed skill is selected.

similarSkillGroups.notes: If both selected, add physical bonuses. Duplicated abilities use the best proficiency; educational bonus once. Bundled Prowl/Climb do not increase with level unless separately selected.
